quarters.notes: THIS IS THE CONTROL QUARTER and it produced a two-part, informative result, NOT a simple identity: (1) REVENUE: the filed standalone 'Total revenue from Operations' is 1749.27 -- IDENTICAL to consolidated (1749.27), and IDENTICAL to what we already store as revC. Our stored revS (1736.42) does NOT match the filed standalone total at all -- 1736.42 is the filing's 'Interest Income' SUB-LINE (one of six components that sum to Total revenue from Operations), not the Total row. So the revenue 'divergence' we hold for this quarter (1736.42 vs 1749.27) is a PARSING DEFECT in our own std slot (it captured a sub-component instead of the total), not a genuine standalone-vs-consolidated business difference -- the true filed figures are identical on both bases. (2) PAT: the filing shows a real, tiny, fully-reconciled difference -- std 411.76 vs con 411.71 (delta Rs0.05cr = 0.012%), driven by HUDCO's equity-method share of its one associate (SUIDL) posting a small loss that quarter (unlike 2025-26 quarters where the same associate's contribution rounded to exactly zero). Our stored PAT (sf_revop patC=411.71, sf_fundamentals npStd=npCon=411.71, same announce-date 20220808 on both) holds 411.71 for BOTH slots -- i.e. our stored STD PAT is itself a (very small, immaterial) copy of the CON figure, missing the genuine 411.76. CONCLUSION ON THE CONTROL: the method DID detect a real, non-copy, independently-computed difference in the primary document (Rs0.05cr PAT gap, exactly reconciled to the associate line) -- proving the method's sensitivity is not a blind spot. It ALSO surfaced that what our own store treats as 'the known divergent quarter' is mostly a false signal on the revenue side (a std-slot parsing bug, not a genuine con/std split) and an UNDER-signal on the PAT side (we currently show false identity, masking a real but immaterial Rs0.05cr gap). Neither finding supports 'CON_IS_A_COPY' as a defect class -- in both directions (revenue and PAT) the CONSOLIDATED figure is the one that is independently and correctly computed by HUDCO; where our own STORE is wrong, it is because the STANDALONE slot was mis-populated (wrong sub-line for revenue; a copy of con, missing an immaterial associate adjustment, for PAT), which is the mirror image of a 'con is a copy of std' defect and out of this campaign's scope to heal (no repo writes per mandate).
